49 -> 51. `_get_call_name_if_gettext` now looks through a `%` or `.format()` applied to the result, so `raise ValueError(_("...") % x)` is no longer read as clean. The two are `website_snippet_filter.py:217` and `odoo/tools/translate.py:997`.

First baseline. The floor used to be a Python literal in the test module; twenty-four of test_lint's last forty commits changed nothing there but an integer and the comment above it, and five of the six gates red at 598cf211cc2 were floor drift rather than defects. `assert_ratchet` now takes a gate name and refuses an integer outright, so a floor cannot go back into Python. Measured at CI scope -- `--addons-path=odoo/addons,addons`, only test_lint installed -- against a `git archive` of HEAD carrying this change and nothing else, because the shared checkout holds other sessions' uncommitted work.
